policy.statement: Every runtime dependency is inventoried with reason and review date. Adding a dependency without a registry row fails npm run check.
policy.scope: runtime dependencies of workspace packages; devDependencies and peerDependencies are outside this registry

dependencies.name: web-push
dependencies.reason: RFC 8291 payload encryption and RFC 8292 VAPID signing for browser notifications; network requests use the NND bounded, DNS-pinned HTTPS transport

dependencies.name: ipaddr.js
dependencies.reason: Classify public IPv4 and IPv6 destinations before outbound Web Push; reject private, mapped, reserved and transition addresses

dependencies.name: hono
dependencies.reason: Server routing for the ~253-route surface (doc 03); typed middleware, native Response streaming for SSE

dependencies.name: @hono/node-server
dependencies.reason: Node adapter for Hono; Electron main process will embed createApp via the same adapter (doc 09)

dependencies.name: ws
dependencies.reason: Terminal binary WebSocket transport (0x01+JSON frames, 64 KiB cap, protocol v3 per doc 07 section 3); one socket multiplexes every attached terminal

dependencies.name: node-pty
dependencies.reason: PTY backend for the terminal subsystem (doc 07 section 4): useConpty on Windows, process-group kill on POSIX; doc-named backend when not running under Bun

dependencies.name: cron-parser
dependencies.reason: Cron occurrence iteration for scheduled tasks (doc 12 C.2): tz-aware next() shared by server dispatch and the future UI preview so preview and schedule agree by construction

dependencies.name: @simplewebauthn/server
dependencies.reason: Passkey (WebAuthn) ceremony (doc 08 section 2.4): server-side registration/authentication option generation and attestation/assertion verification, wrapped by the WebAuthnCeremony seam

dependencies.name: @simplewebauthn/browser
dependencies.reason: Client half of the passkey ceremonies (doc 08 §2.5): startRegistration/startAuthentication + WebAuthnError codes consumed by the session gate and settings page; pairs with @simplewebauthn/server above

dependencies.name: qrcode
dependencies.reason: Pairing QR face (doc 08 §5.8): toDataURL of the connection payload for the mobile camera; server never renders the QR

dependencies.name: qrcode-terminal
dependencies.reason: CLI connect-url --qr render (doc 08 §5.9 / doc 03 §10.1): small QR to the terminal; the printed link is exactly the pairing-v2 link

dependencies.name: react
dependencies.reason: UI layer (doc 05); useSyncExternalStore binding for the sync engine leaf selectors

dependencies.name: react-dom
dependencies.reason: Client DOM render; required for the Vite web runtime mount

dependencies.name: zustand
dependencies.reason: Vanilla StoreApi state for directory stores and global sidecars (doc 04.store semantics)

dependencies.name: sonner
dependencies.reason: Toast surface for permission/question tasks and send-failure notices (docs 04/05)

dependencies.name: yaml
dependencies.reason: cloudflared managed-local tunnel configs are .yml/.yaml; the ingress[].hostname extraction parses the file like the reference (doc 08 section 4.3, yaml.parse)

dependencies.name: @notnative/ui
dependencies.reason: Workspace seam package: the web entry mounts the shared UI and swaps against it
